description: Repairs r-dao-1-err-1/index-metadata-seek: rs.Index("PrimaryKey") gave 3800 because the fixture's primary key is named PK_T, so every later Seek ran with no current index (3019 or 3001) and the Seek arity and error-order evidence is void. A table-type recordset on T; Index put to 'PK_T' (the name of T's primary key), read Errors, read Index; Seek('=', 3), read Errors, NoMatch and the row; Seek with 13 key arguments (Long 1), read Errors and NoMatch; Seek with 14 key arguments, read Errors; Seek with the comparison 'bogus' and one key, read Errors. Asks the Seek arity limit and the error order on a recordset whose current index is set. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
